scope: Fixed demo only: flat stationary desk REST vs continuous hand movement/shaking MOVING
limitations: Two held-out sessions with correlated overlapping windows; no broad generalization claim. Holdout scores were already known for Model A; Model B uses the specified architecture and identical fixed training settings, with no holdout-based tuning or model selection.

runtime.execution: Laptop production Engine with reference and ESP-NN ANSI kernels
runtime.limitation: Does not exercise ESP32-S3 assembly kernels or establish target RAM/latency
